capabilities.name: Control mode
capabilities.summary: Attach a library-managed control client and stream events.

capabilities.name: Named buffer deletion
capabilities.summary: Delete one paste buffer by name without risking another buffer. paste_bytes and paste_text keep working below it by deleting their own staging buffer with paste-buffer -d.

capabilities.name: Buffer rename
capabilities.summary: Rename a paste buffer without risking another buffer.

capabilities.name: Layouts without a checksum
capabilities.summary: Apply a layout string that opens like a dumped layout; tmux 3.3 and 3.3a stop on any other operand.

capabilities.name: Clipboard query
capabilities.summary: Ask an attached client's terminal for its clipboard with refresh-client -l. tmux 3.3a stops when the client's terminal does not answer; 3.4 to 3.6 stop when the client leaves before its terminal answers.

capabilities.name: Mirrored main layouts
capabilities.summary: Apply the main-horizontal-mirrored and main-vertical-mirrored layouts.

capabilities.name: JSON layout strings
capabilities.summary: Apply a layout saved in the JSON form tmux reports. The library requires the 3.8 release, so 3.8 release candidates are refused although they accept it.

workarounds.name: Colon and dot in names
workarounds.summary: tmux 3.7 rejects ':' and '.' in session and window names, so the library refuses them first.

workarounds.name: break-pane window naming
workarounds.summary: tmux 3.7 stops on a break-pane without a window name and ignores -n. The library refuses the nameless form in raw command lines and in break_pane, and break_pane renames the window afterwards.
